notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, targeting Shield Sphere.
When Kobolds of Kher Keep dies, Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Shield Sphere.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Shield Sphere, targeting Kobolds of Kher Keep.
When Shield Sphere dies, Koll triggers, returning Shield Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.
